notes.title: F.L.I.R. System: Personalize Your Gameplay with Unique Visuals!
notes.content:
Attention Airmen! 

The undead apocalypse has never looked this good! 

We're thrilled to introduce the new F.L.I.R. system in Zombie Gunship Survival, offering you the chance to customize your visual experience like never before. These filters bring a fresh twist to your missions, enhancing the atmosphere and making every encounter more immersive.

The F.L.I.R. system introduces two new distinct visual styles, in addition to the original. Now, you can view the battlefield from a whole new perspective. With a simple press of the F.L.I.R button on your screen, effortlessly switch between three thermal filters in real-time, tailoring your view to suit your preferences. Your choices are saved, ensuring your favorite style is always ready at your fingertips.

Our updated tutorial will help you get acquainted with these new options, making it easy to find the perfect look for your zombie-slaying escapades.

[b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b]

[u]Abort Mission Confirmation:[/u]
Added a confirmation prompt to prevent accidental mission exits.

[u]Quit Game Confirmation Button on Steam:[/u]
Steam users now have an added confirmation button when quitting the game.

[u]Workshop Button:[/u]
New Workshop buttons in Player Base and Armory for quick access.

[u]Mission Timer UI:[/u]
Enhanced mission timer UI for clearer, more responsive tracking.

Start exploring the apocalypse with a fresh perspective — your gunship awaits!

notes.title: 1.6.57 Version Notes - Anniversary Edition
notes.content:
Greetings, Airmen and Survivors! 
 
 
5 years ago, HQ reached out to all the Survivors of the Zombie Apocalypse! A great number of brave volunteers responded and enrolled to become true Airmen. 
We sincerely thank you for that, as this is what made the fight, the missions, the battles, and the journey of the past 5 years amazing!
 
At a time like this, we cannot help but reflect on the wonderful things we are grateful for. Just a handful of the noteworthy ones from the previous year:
 
 
[list]
[*] ​​WoTMs: we all learned to play with the Big Guns now (! but what WoTMs and their added abilities); We are incredibly proud that the squad completed with flying colors the WoTM training and looking forward to the future ones!
[*] This year’s Anniversary also marks one year since we engaged in more complex, competitive battles: one full year of Resurgences, Titan Hunts, and Boss Rushes.
[*] The Steam Version of the game and the much-needed additional Air Support received from the Steam Airmen.
[*] ZGS Community migrated to a different home; We have seen the Discord Server and Reddit flourish to offer easy-to-access channels for all Airmen who wish to become part of the unique ZGS community with all its magic.
[/list]
 
 
All this would not be possible without the dedicated Airmen, who continue to amaze and inspire us with their ambition, skills, and strategy.

The launch of the current version (1.6.57) is also the beginning of the 
5 Year Anniversary Celebrations
Everyone is invited!


Get ready for the Anniversary surprises, including but not limited to:

[list]
[*] A New Game Mode 
[*] New Weapons 
[*] New Leaderboard events 
[/list]

Stay tuned to learn more about what the following weeks have in store for you, as HQ Announcements will be made at relevant times.
We all look forward to the upcoming 5 (and more) years to come!

Lock and Load!
ZGS Team

notes.title: Update 1.6.43
notes.content:
Salute Airmen! New Challenges ahead!

Update 1.6.43 will be landing soon and we’ve got some interesting stuff going on!


New Maps

Three new maps are available for you to explore!

Empty Advance: Not only outnumbered, but flanked as well. Careful, Airman. A few errant Wreckers and this mission goes straight to hell, much like the rest of the world.

Zero-Sum Bias: The stream is endless. Unless you use the terrain to your advantage, we may not survive the night. Let’s try not to get eaten, yeah?

Chaos Front: We’re in the heart of enemy territory now, Airman. We can deploy no further than that, so we’ll have to traverse the maze. Pray for good aim and big explosions, we’re gonna need them.

Prepare your gunship troopers, as these new maps yield really cool rewards from the common crates!




New Weapons

The new T96 is already available in all seasonal crates and it is a bad boy. You can find out more details about it in our previous communications (will insert IG or FB link here link here).



Leaderboard event

That’s right! a new Leaderboard event is coming…

We will be Thanksgiving with a special “Pilgrim’s March” event that will see a leaderboard structure in place! Stay tuned, as more details will be shared with you in a separate post!


Hunting season is open. To arms, soldiers!

notes.title: Update 1.6.40 is now available
notes.content:
We Salute You!

Listen up Airmen, new intel has arrived from HQ! We have reached new territories and new weapons are now available.
 

[b]Three new missions[/b]
Renounced Limits 
Break the barrier and take your prize, but be wary, soldiers, the enemy follows. And it hungers.

Solitary March 
What abominations hide in the ruins of a lost world? Can you reach your goal without awakening the past from its slumber?

Divided Earth 
Are your troops ready? Are you? Don’t hesitate, don’t miss, or the divided earth will swallow them whole.
 
[b] 
New Weapons [/b]
The November Weapon of the Month is ready to go! An improved SNPR20, the RUPTURE has an extra  300% damage as damage over time and other cool features developed by the Mechanic. 
It will be available starting the 1st of November. It’s a hard weapon to master, but if you do, it can bring about fantastic results.

With this latest update, a brand new cannon class weapon enters the scene. The T96 Cannon is here to double the trouble! A close relative to the M777, it shoots two shells at once and makes for a perfect Wrecker killing machine. Watch out for the overheating system!
 
[b]New Event[/b]
With Halloween being just around the corner, get ready for a new Resurgence event! More details to come in a future ZGS official communication. Keep an eye open on all channels!


Good hunting!
